Chapter 455 - 455 Game; Human Resources Director! (2)

Chapter 455 - 455 Game; Human Resources Director! (2)

455 Game; Human Resources Director! (2)

In order to pass the time, they went to Weibo, forums, and other places to share the joy brought by the gaming helmet.

Meanwhile, Hao Zhiwu sent out messages in the WeChat group that consisted of Professor Lin’s students.

Hao Zhiwu: [It’s a pity that you guys didn’t ask Professor Lin to help you get a spot for the closed beta!]

Hao Zhiwu: [After wearing the helmet, I get to hit monsters with rocks. It’s like I’m fighting monsters in the real world. There’s also the fruit in the game. The taste is amazing…]

Hao Zhiwu: [I’m sure that as long as you guys play this game, you’ll definitely fall in love with it!]

Finally, someone replied.

Liu Qianqian: [It’s very fun. Come in and play with us!]

When Hao Zhiwu saw this message, he was slightly stunned.

After a while, he finally sent another message.

Hao Zhiwu: [What do you mean?]

Liu Qianqian: [It’s just putting on the gaming helmet and playing in the world together.]

Liu Qianqian: [This morning, Professor Lin brought six gaming helmets to the office. We’ve been playing for hours.]

Liu Qianqian: [My stomach is still a little uncomfortable, so I took the helmet off for a while. I’m going back in now.]

Liu Qianqian: [Alright, let’s not talk anymore. I’m going to put on the gaming helmet now. Otherwise, I’ll be far behind Professor Lin and the others.]

After Hao Zhiwu saw the news, he suddenly clutched his chest.

It hurt!

It hurt!

He had to beg Professor Lin before he was able to obtain a spot in the beta testing for the gaming helmet on the last day.

As a result, he had to stay in the branch of Dahua Group for 14 days as if he were in prison.

14 days…

Moreover, he could only play with the gaming helmet for 56 hours.

Now?

Now, Liu Qianqian was telling him that Professor Lin had brought six gaming helmets to the office and let everyone play as they pleased!

This…

This…

Hao Zhiwu leaned against the window like a prisoner who had been wronged. He cried and howled, “Let me out!”

…

In the next 14 days, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Liu Qianqian, Nie Zhenjiang, and Jiang Chaoqun were very happy every day as they could game while studying.

Hao Zhiwu, who was in Dahua Group, would come to the window every day after he finished gaming. His face was full of sorrow, and he could not help but sigh.

Finally, the closed beta ended.

The people who participated in the closed beta were still not satisfied, but they slowly left Dahua Group.

Hao Zhiwu was the only one who ran out like a sharp arrow.

When he arrived at Jiangbei University, before he even entered the office, he shouted, “Professor Lin, I want it, I want it!”

Lin Fan’s lips twitched. “What do you mean you want it? If you want to play with the gaming helmet, take it yourself.”

As he spoke, he pointed at a gaming helmet on the table.

“Yes, Professor!” Hao Zhiwu said excitedly.

Then, he hurriedly picked up the gaming helmet, found a good position, and put it on his head impatiently. He entered the game world again and began to gallop freely.

When Hao Zhiwu entered the game world again, the news about the gaming helmet on the internet once again caused a heated discussion.

Some people said that gaming helmets could harm the brain.

Some people said that gaming helmets would make people unable to differentiate between reality and virtual reality.

Some people said that gaming helmets would make people more addicted to the internet and become the drug of the new era.

Of course, most people were looking forward to the promotion of the gaming helmet.

If the creator of the gaming helmet had been anyone else, they would definitely be paying close attention to this news.

However, Lin Fan did not care at all.

He went to the office on time every day. Sometimes, he would return to the Coiling Dragon Villa to rest; sometimes, he would go to Yi Ke City; and sometimes, he would go to Washington Palace… He was very content.

…

Today.

As usual, Lin Fan went to Jiangbei University after breakfast.

In the past, when Lin Fan walked around the school, every student’s face was filled with youthful and sunny smiles.

These days, he noticed that many students had a faint look of worry on their faces.

A gentle breeze blew from the side, bringing with it a light fragrance.

Lin Fan turned around.

He saw…

A woman with smooth skin, a face like a peach blossom, hair like a waterfall, and a perfect figure slowly walking over.

It was Hu Tian.

“Teacher Tiantian, good morning.”

Hu Tian smiled and said, “You’re a professor like me now, but you’re still calling me Teacher Tiantian?”

Lin Fan smiled. “Can’t I?”

The two of them talked and chatted very casually.

If it were in the past, the two of them would feel a little uncomfortable walking side by side.

After all, it was a teacher-student relationship.

Now that both of them were teachers and professors, it seemed much more natural.

At this moment, a slightly ear-piercing cry suddenly sounded not far away.

“Hu Tian!”

Then, a tall and thin man in a suit strode over.

He smiled and said, “Hu Tian, long time no see!”

When Hu Tian saw who it was, she first revealed a puzzled expression.

Then, she said with some uncertainty, “Are you… Zheng Cong?”

When Zheng Cong heard Hu Tian call out his name, he said happily, “It’s me!”

“Why did you come to school today?” Hu Tian asked in surprise.

Zheng Cong was Hu Tian’s former classmate at Jiangbei University.

After graduating from university, the two of them had not met again.

Now that they suddenly met, they were naturally surprised.

“Isn’t it almost graduation season?” Zheng Cong laughed.

“The employment situation of university students is not very good now. I’m now the human resources director of Huidong Accounting Firm, and I happen to be in charge of recruiting interns, so I came to Jiangbei University.

“After all, it’s better for our school to have the advantage.”

After he said this, he could not help but stick out his chest, his face full of pride.

This was because Huidong was one of the top ten accounting firms in the country.

Be it salary or benefits, they were all very good.

It was the ideal place for many graduates to work.

He felt that after he said these words, Hu Tian would definitely praise him.

However, Hu Tian only said in a very calm tone, “Is that so? Congratulations.”

However, Zheng Cong did not seem to notice the calmness in her tone. He smiled and said, “I’m just the human resources director of Huidong Accounting Firm. What’s there to congratulate me for? Congratulate me after I become the chairman.”

His tone was so relaxed.

That appearance…

It was as if it was so easy to become the chairman of Huidong Accounting Firm.

Zheng Cong was already immersed in his own world, unable to extricate himself.

Then, he said, “We haven’t seen each other for a long time. Are you free to have a meal together later?”

After saying this, a fiery look flashed across Zheng Cong’s eyes.

When Hu Tian was in university, she was the famous campus belle of Jiangbei University.

Zheng Cong and many other boys were fascinated by her.

However, Hu Tian was indifferent to everyone.

This made everyone very helpless.

In fact…

Zheng Cong came to Jiangbei University to recruit interns mainly because he knew that Hu Tian was a professor at Jiangbei University and that she was still unmarried.

This could not help but make Zheng Cong feel a sense of fantasy and anticipation.

With his current status, if he met Hu Tian at Jiangbei University, perhaps…

Lin Fan, who was standing at the side, could tell what Zheng Cong was thinking. He said, “I’m afraid that’s not possible because Teacher Tiantian has already decided to have dinner with me tonight.”

He wanted to have a meal with his woman?

Had he asked him?

Zheng Cong finally seemed to have noticed Lin Fan and asked, “You’re Professor Hu Tian’s student, right?

“Professor Hu and I were very close classmates back then. For Professor Hu’s sake, I can make the decision to let you join Huidong Accounting Firm directly.”

He believed that as long as he said that, Lin Fan would definitely be overwhelmed and overjoyed.
